Fix `packages/element/src/Scene.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Regression introduced by this run (all of these passed on the unchanged tree, baseline-checks-v3): yarn test:app --watch=false now fails render-count assertions in 6 existing suites: dragCreate.test.tsx (renderInteractiveScene expected 5, received 9), selection.test.tsx (expected 3 calls, got 5), multiPointCreate.test.tsx, move.test.tsx, linearElementEditor.test.tsx, renderOverrides.test.tsx ("expected renderStaticScene to not be called at all, but actually been called 1 times"). Cause: App.componentDidUpdate calls this.scene.setActivePage(this.state.activePageId, this.state.pages.map(p => p.id)) on every update; Scene.setActivePage always re-runs updateActivePageElements (new arrays) and calls triggerUpdate when any element reference changed, so every element edit during a drag fires an extra scene update. NFR-3 requires no extra per-frame work when the scene and active page have not changed. Make setActivePage a no-op (no recompute, no triggerUpdate) when activePageId and the page id set are unchanged and filtering is already on; recompute the active-page arrays only where Scene already recomputes its non-deleted arrays (replaceAllElements / element mutation), so the render counts in those 6 suites return to their recorded values. Do not change the tests.
